description: This file implements logging functions for a C project, including setting log file paths, logging messages with timestamps, and prefix logging with optional color code stripping.

methods.name: UT_log_setLogFilePath
methods.description: Sets the log file path and filename with timestamp.

methods.name: UT_log
methods.description: Logs a message with timestamp, function name, and line number to file and stdout.

methods.name: UT_logPrefix
methods.description: Logs a prefixed message with timestamp, prefix, filename, and line number, stripping color codes.

methods.name: UT_stripColorCode
methods.description: Removes ANSI color codes from a string.
